mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, sender_id, type, content, read_at, created_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{readAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE messages SET conversation_id = #{conversationId}, sender_id = #{senderId}, type = #{type}, content = #{content}, read_at = #{readAt}, created_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id}
